This article compares the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who experience an intracranial bleed within one year (Indicator 13) across national, regional, and local health clusters in Denmark [^src1]. The data highlights significant geographic variation in this severe adverse event, with rates generally remaining low but spiking in specific smaller clusters.

Nationally, [[danmark|Danmark]] reports an intracranial bleeding rate of 0.8% (173 out of 21,804 patients) in the current year, which remains stable compared to previous years (0.7% and 0.8%) [^src1]. Among the five administrative regions, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] reports a rate of 1.0%, while [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] records the lowest regional rate at 0.5% [^src1]. 

When examining local health clusters, the highest rates of intracranial bleeding are found in [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] at 1.5% (3 out of 195 patients), followed by [[klynge-syd|Klynge SYD]] in North Jutland at 1.3%, and both [[sundhedsklyngen-nykoebing-f|Sundhedsklyngen Nykøbing F]] and [[sundhedsklynge-sydvestjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sydvestjylland]] at 1.2% [^src1]. Conversely, the lowest rates are observed in Klynge MIDT at 0.0% (0 out of 866 patients), [[sundhedsklynge-midt|Sundhedsklynge Midt]] in the Capital Region at 0.4%, and both [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] and [[sundhedsklyngen-holbaek|Sundhedsklyngen Holbæk]] at 0.5% [^src1].

The table includes a column for "Standard opfyldt" (Standard met), which shows "0 (0)" across all geographic units, indicating that no entity is flagged as meeting a predefined quality standard or threshold for this indicator in the current reporting period [^src1]. 

Comparing the current year to previous years within the same dataset reveals notable local fluctuations, particularly in smaller clusters where absolute patient numbers are low. For instance, [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] increased from 0.0% (0 out of 186) in previous years to 1.5% [^src1]. In contrast, Klynge MIDT saw a drop from 0.6% to 0.0%, and [[sundhedsklyngen-suh|Sundhedsklyngen SUH]] decreased from 0.7% to 0.6% [^src1]. However, because these figures are derived from a single dated table section, they represent point-in-time year-over-year comparisons rather than long-term multi-sectional trends.
